text:
tanya.fin: Quick alert 1 PioneerMed has placed INV-2026-1420 on hold. They claim the platform fee line is duplicated and the renewal addendum price doesn't match the signed quote. Can someone fetch the metering export and contract event log?

harry.revops: On it. Do we have the invoice PDF? Also, did the customer do an on-demand capacity add-on last week? That can create an extra PLATFORM-ADD SKU which sometimes confuses the invoice generator.

isabel.am: They did sign an amendment on 2026-05-02 to add a DR cluster (annex A) and also renewed the private license early on 2026-05-01 to lock pricing. SEs confirmed a 4-day validation window for the DR cluster (complimentary). Might be overlap between renewal, amendment and the DR trial mapping.

tanya.fin: Invoice excerpt pasted below:
```
INV-2026-1420
 - PRIVATE-LICENSE-PIONEER qty 1 $20,000 annual
 - PLATFORM-PIONEER qty 1 $20,000 annual
 - SUPPORT-PREM-PIONEER qty 1 $6,000 annual
 - PLATFORM-PIONEER qty 1 $20,000 annual (duplicate?)
 - PLATFORM-DR-TRIAL qty 1 $0 desc: DR cluster trial (should be $0 for trial period)
```

jo.billing: Metering export uploaded: /billing/exports/2026-05/pioneer_20260510.csv by metering-scheduler at 2026-05-10T07:10Z. Pulling now.

metering-bot: [system] export ready at /billing/exports/2026-05/pioneer_20260510.csv

jo.billing: I pulled the CSV. There are three active commitments during May: legacy commit L-111 (ends 2026-05-31), renewal R-222 (start 2026-05-01), and amendment AM-333 (DR cluster trial 2026-05-03 -> 2026-05-06). The migration/mapper flow created a new PLATFORM SKU for R-222 but the legacy platform SKU wasn't retired because the renewal happened early. The amendment also incorrectly mapped DR trial to a billable platform line in one code path. So two platform_fee lines and a mis-mapped trial.

harry.revops: That's a twofold bug: 1) early renewals should emit an end_date on legacy SKUs; 2) amendments with trial flags should map to TRIAL-DR SKU, not PLATFORM. I'll open ENG-4684 and ENG-4685 with suggested fixes and add regression tests.

eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4684 created by harry.revops: "migration/renewal flow failing to retire legacy platform SKU on early renewals" https://eng.redwood/ENG-4684
eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4685 created by harry.revops: "billing-mapper misclassifies DR amendment trial as platform SKU" https://eng.redwood/ENG-4685

isabel.am: Customer expectation: complimentary 4-day DR validation 2026-05-03 -> 2026-05-06. Procurement is holding payment until corrected. Need corrected invoice + credit memo and explanation. Also confirm renewal price matches signed addendum (they say price in portal is +$2,000 over quote).

tanya.fin: Jo, compute prorates and credit needed. Also check the renewal addendum pricing in Salesforce and the signed PDF.

jo.billing: Pricing checks: signed addendum (AMEND-455) shows renewal at $20,000 and DR cluster trial set to $0 for first 30 days. Portal invoice incorrectly included the duplicate $20,000 platform line plus erroneously applied a $2,000 surcharge from an earlier draft quote that should not have been active. I will compute amounts now.

jo.billing: Platform daily = 20000 / 365 = 54.7945. Duplicate overlap window charged 31 days (2026-05-01 -> 2026-05-31) -> $1,697.63. DR trial mis-billed 4 days at platform rate -> $219.18 (should be $0). Erroneous surcharge $2,000 applied -> must be removed. Support proration: premium billed full year but should be pro-rated for the 4 complimentary days -> credit small (~$73.16). Total credit = 1,697.63 + 219.18 + 2,000 + 73.16 = $3,989.97. Rounding -> $3,989.97. Draft CREDIT-2026-0603 and corrected invoice INV-2026-1420A uploaded to /billing/credits and /billing/invoices/drafts.

isabel.am: I'll forward the signed AMEND-455 and SE confirm email to billing for records. Customers want a short note for procurement explaining the correction and the steps we took to fix mapping.

harry.revops: Patch to migration + mapper repos in review. I'll add unit test asserting: no more than one platform SKU active per customer-day, amendments with trial flag must map to TRIAL-DR SKU, and old quotes/surcharges must not apply after addendum signature. Scheduling a 48h canary.

tanya.fin: Approved. Jo, please apply credit and push corrected invoice to portal. Also add account note referencing ENG-4684/ENG-4685 and tag me. If they escalate, we may need to loop in CSM.

jo.billing: Applied CREDIT-2026-0603 and pushed INV-2026-1420A to customer portal at 2026-05-11T18:02Z. Notified account team and cc'd procurement.

isabel.am: Customer reply: "Thanks, invoice now matches signed addendum. We'll release payment once portal shows credit." :thumbsup:

harry.revops: ENG-4684/4685 set to "in review" and canary started. Will post scan results for other early renewals tomorrow.

tanya.fin: Great work. Closing the hold; will follow up at weekly finance review to ensure no other accounts affected."
